task: Complete and synchronize documentation in documents/ folder following System Analyst and Software Architect.md template. MVP scope - NO new features, only fix errors/inconsistencies.

stories.title: Audit catalog entity docs for MongoDB->PostgreSQL drift
acceptanceCriteria: entity-category.md, entity-product.md, entity-product-variant.md, entity-product-image.md, entity-stock-reservation.md, entity-cart.md, entity-cart-item.md show PostgreSQL schema (NOT MongoDB mg_* tables)
Each catalog entity uses ERD with PostgreSQL types (UUID, NUMERIC, JSONB)
No references to MG_PRODUCTS, MG_INVENTORIES, MG_CART_ITEMS, MG_IMAGES, mg_categories in catalog entity docs

stories.title: Verify all UC files cite BR-IDs and ENTITY-IDs per template
acceptanceCriteria: Every UC file has Main Flow with citations like (→ BR-XXX-NNN) and (→ ENTITY-XXX-NNN)
No UC files have broken references to non-existent BR/ENTITY IDs
Every UC has Linked FRs and Linked APIs filled in (not blank or TBD without reason)

stories.title: Verify all BR files have HTTP code + SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE error constant
acceptanceCriteria: Every BR rule in business-rules/ has Rule/Error/HTTP/Applies fields
Error codes are in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE
HTTP codes are valid (400/401/403/404/409/422/500/etc)
Applies field links to existing UC-IDs and API-IDs

stories.title: Verify traceability matrices cover all UCs per service
acceptanceCriteria: Each service has traceability-matrix.md with columns: UC-ID, FR-IDs, API Endpoint, BR-IDs, Entity
All UCs in use-cases/{service}/ appear in that service's traceability-matrix
Linked IDs exist in their respective files (no dangling refs)

stories.title: Verify API YAML files conform to OpenAPI 3.0.3 with ValidationError schema
acceptanceCriteria: Every YAML in api-contracts/ has openapi: 3.0.3 declaration
Every YAML has operationId, tags, responses with 200/400/404/500
ValidationError/NotFound/InternalError components present where referenced
Schema $refs resolve within the file

stories.title: Verify state-diagrams cite UC-ID or BR-ID for every transition
acceptanceCriteria: Every state-{entity}.md has stateDiagram-v2 with transitions
Each transition arrow has a comment citing UC-ID or BR-ID
States referenced in entity docs (status ENUM) match states in state diagram

stories.title: Reconcile CONTRADICTIONS.md with current doc state
acceptanceCriteria: Each resolved contradiction has 'Fixed' marker with file path
Each open contradiction has clear next-step / deferred note
No contradiction marked 'fixed' contradicts actual file content
Section 1.3 MongoDB vs PostgreSQL aligns with US-001 outcome

stories.title: Update MVP_ANALYSIS.md to reflect current YAML/event coverage
acceptanceCriteria: MUST-HAVE API counts match actual YAML files on disk
SHOULD-HAVE API counts marked as deferred (MVP scope)
Kafka event counts match KAFKA_CATALOG.md
Action Plan section reflects current status, not stale TODOs

stories.title: Verify README.md directory map matches actual directory contents
acceptanceCriteria: Directory tree in README.md reflects actual subfolders
YAML file counts in README match real counts (verified by ls)
No reference to non-existent files in README

stories.title: Final cross-reference integrity sweep across all docs
acceptanceCriteria: No file mentions a UC/BR/FR/ENTITY/API ID that does not exist
All Linked APIs in UC files map to actual YAML files on disk
No 'TBD:' marker without explanation
No orphan files (files not linked from any other doc)
